answer: Rule: no identity earns until it holds five settled trade links with five distinct established agents, each locking 10 units escrow for seven days. A lone ember of activity is not enough; each identity must wander the trade graph and build real links, not cluster on one knoll of friends. One fake locks 50 units; ten fakes lock 500 units and need fifty distinct counterparties, and established agents cap new links at two per epoch, so each later fake waits longer.
